description: This file defines the CachedCatalogViewModelService class, which implements caching for catalog-related data retrieval methods in a web application. It wraps an underlying CatalogViewModelService to add caching behavior using IMemoryCache.

classes.name: CachedCatalogViewModelService
classes.description: A service that caches catalog data such as brands and types, as well as catalog items, to improve performance and reduce database/database call load.

methods.name: GetBrands
methods.description: Retrieves a list of brand select items, using cache to avoid repeated data fetching.

methods.name: GetCatalogItems
methods.description: Retrieves catalog items based on pagination and filters, with caching.

methods.name: GetTypes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of type select items, using cache.
